chapter_name: The State, the Government, and You
learning_objective: 🎯 Understand how our country is managed, what the government does to keep things running smoothly, and discover your own superpower as an active citizen in a democracy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like a school needs a principal and teachers to function smoothly, a country needs a government! It makes rules, builds schools and roads, and keeps everyone safe and organized.
India is the world's largest democracy! This means the ultimate power belongs to the people. Adult citizens use their magical power of voting during elections to choose who will lead the country.

To make sure no one has too much power, our government is split into three teams. The Legislature makes the laws, the Executive puts them into action, and the Judiciary (courts) makes sure justice is served fairly.

Being a citizen is not just about having rights; it is also about responsibilities! Helping your neighbors, keeping your city clean, and respecting others are ways you can be an amazing citizen right now.

fun_activity.title: 🏛️ Be the Chief Minister!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you have been chosen to lead your state for one day. Grab a notebook and write down 3 fun but fair rules you would make to improve your city or village!

quick_recap: ⭐ The government provides important services, makes laws, and protects the country.
⭐ In a democracy, citizens have the right to vote and elect their own leaders.
⭐ The government is divided into three branches: Legislature, Executive, and Judiciary.
⭐ Good citizens participate in their communities and balance their rights with responsibilities.
